pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel beside Amsterdam Amstel station, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and quick public transport connections.

Family and budget stay

Choose a private family room for your household rather than individual beds in a shared dorm. The hotel offers family rooms, a guest kitchen and shared common areas. Check the exact bed layout, occupancy, bathroom arrangement and any cot requirements for your selected room.

Amstel station provides rail and metro connections for exploring the city. This is outside the central canal belt: allow public transport time for museums and central sights. Compare private-room totals with taxes, breakfast, parking, laundry and other extras; a dorm-bed lead price is a different product.

Opening

The operator records opening on 25 March 2018 with 186 rooms and 806 beds. These are the opening figures rather than a claim about current inventory. The hotel forms part of Amstel Tower; no whole-tower construction price is attributed to the hotel.

pin.longFormSummary:
A compact, design-led Kinshicho hotel with a social lobby, bar and gym; compare dates and allow train travel to other Tokyo neighbourhoods.

Compact city stay

Marriott confirms the hotel opened on 1 November 2017. MICHELIN lists this 205-room property and describes it as a relatively affordable design option, with compact rooms and a shared social centre.

Condé Nast Traveler’s review supports its value positioning while noting small entry-level rooms. Compare your actual dates, room layout and total price; there is no current guaranteed low nightly rate.

The Kinshicho setting suits visitors comfortable using trains to explore Tokyo. Check your routes and room occupancy before booking. Breakfast, meals and other extras depend on the rate selected.

Guide recognition

The MICHELIN hotel selection is verified. A MICHELIN Key award is not claimed.
